_doc: Documented harmless strings of the production bundle scan (scripts/scan-prod-bundles.mjs). An entry matches a FINDING by its kind and by a regex over the +-60 characters around it; every entry needs a reason, and an entry that never matched in the last scan is reported as stale (not an error: it depends on what was built). Nothing here may be an address that the browser could actually call.

allow.reason: the WHATWG URL parser polyfill: `if ("localhost" === url.host) url.host = ""` for file: URLs. A comparison literal, never a request target.
secure-context checks of Next.js / React runtime code (is this host exempt from the https requirement). A comparison, never a request target.
